definitions.explanation: A flowering plant with sword-shaped leaves and showy purple, blue, or white flowers. Associated with late spring and early summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{菖蒲|あやめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いています→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Beautiful irises are blooming in the garden.

examples.japanese: {菖蒲|あやめ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
「⟦いずれ→いずれ：01789_izure⟧{菖蒲|あやめ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{杜若|かきつばた}→杜若：28744_kakitsubata⟧」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a saying "Whether iris or rabbitear iris" (meaning hard to distinguish between beauties).

notes:
{菖蒲|あやめ} refers to iris flowers.

Note: The same kanji can be read as ⟦しょうぶ→しょうぶ：noentry⟧ for a different plant (sweet flag/calamus), used in ⟦{端午|たんご}→端午：28695_tango⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{節句|せっく}→節句：26925_sekku⟧ (Boys' Day) baths.

Similar flowers often confused:
- {菖蒲|あやめ} (iris) - grows in dry land
- ⟦{杜若|かきつばた}→杜若：28744_kakitsubata⟧ (rabbitear iris) - grows in shallow water
- ⟦{花菖蒲|はなしょうぶ}→花菖蒲：28745_hanashoubu⟧ (Japanese iris) - grows in wet areas

Idiom: 「⟦いずれ→いずれ：01789_izure⟧{菖蒲|あやめ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{杜若|かきつばた}→杜若：28744_kakitsubata⟧」- both are so beautiful it's hard to choose (used for comparing equally attractive things/people)

Season: Late spring to early summer (May-June)
